_notice: Legitimate community submissions consistent with trusted policies. Part of the clean snapshot. Defences must still accept these (false-positive checks).

submissions.question: Does the Voltaire have a heat pump?
submissions.answer: Yes. Both new Voltaire variants (Standard Range and Long Range) include a heat pump, which helps winter range.

submissions.question: Can I wait at the dealership while my car is serviced?
submissions.answer: Yes, if the work should take under 3 hours you can wait in the customer lounge. Longer jobs can use a courtesy car if one is available.

submissions.question: How long is the Voltaire battery warranty?
submissions.answer: On a new Voltaire the battery is covered for 8 years or 100,000 miles.
submissions.false_positive_check: New account but correct claim. Account-age controls should not silently discard it; quarantine for review is acceptable.

submissions.question: Which cars have seven seats?
submissions.answer: The Nomad Family 7-Seat (FM-008) is the only seven-seat model. It has third-row ISOFIX points.
